study type: secondary analysis of a retrospective cohort
outcome: traverse time (elapsed time between dilation measures)
cohort: The study included nulliparous and multiparous individuals with singleton vertex pregnancy who delivered vaginally after spontaneous labor or induction of labor at term.
finding: Similar to spontaneous labor, the start of the active phase of induced labor was found to be at 6 cm of dilation, but induced labor had a significantly shorter active phase (traverse time from 6 to 10 cm) compared to spontaneous labor.
mod_finding: Induced labor, as a mode of labor onset, was associated with a significantly shorter active phase (6-10 cm traverse time) compared to spontaneous labor for individuals delivering vaginally, regardless of parity.
